facts: dtype_width(1) is exactly 1; dtype_width(2) is exactly 8.
typed_descriptor forwards Bool without the dtype3-only rank restriction, and its exact parent forbids non-F32 requires=1.
own_storage=1 allocates numel*width bytes, creates a new kind3 Version slot, attaches the new Storage/Version to the original T, then drops the temporary allocation Hold.
The Version slot is cleared by so_slot_new before its reference count is initialized. The candidate does not explicitly bump it; actual Bool-sum Version parity remains a new-oracle obligation.
requires=0 bypasses the gradient allocation branch; descriptor zero initialization leaves op0/no AD edges/no Saved/no ViewInfo.
tget uses actual dtype width and checked Storage bounds; taddr computes the real logical-index-to-stride address, including holes, zero stride and offset already stored in the data pointer.
typed_store(width=1) writes exactly one byte. Candidate normalization ensures only 0 or 1 reaches every output store.
The normal publication path has no F32-only requirement.
